import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    n = len(df)

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    amount_null = amount.isna()
    tax_null = tax.isna()

    r1 = amount_null | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax_null | (tax < 0)

    both_present = (~amount_null) & (~tax_null)
    r3 = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    r3[both_present] = tax[both_present] > (amount[both_present] * 0.5)

    r4 = due_date.isna()

    ref_null = customer_ref.isna()
    ref_blank = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    not_null_ref = ~ref_null
    ref_blank[not_null_ref] = customer_ref[not_null_ref].astype(str).str.strip() == ""
    r5 = ref_null | ref_blank

    rules = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    reason_codes = pd.Series([""] * n, index=df.index, dtype=object)
    for mask, code in rules:
        mask_filled = mask.fillna(False)
        sel = mask_filled
        reason_codes[sel] = reason_codes[sel].apply(
            lambda existing, c=code: (existing + "|" + c) if existing else c
        )

    has_failure = reason_codes != ""

    clean = df[~has_failure].copy()
    rejects = df[has_failure].copy()
    rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes[has_failure]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
